maddeler.e:
استمطروا (form X)
# اِسْتَمْطَرُوا (istamṭarū) /is.tam.tˤa.ruː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِسْتَمْطَرَ (istamṭara)
# اُسْتُمْطِرُوا (ustumṭirū) /us.tum.tˤi.ruː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِسْتَمْطَرَ (istamṭara)
# اِسْتَمْطِرُوا (istamṭirū) /is.tam.tˤi.ruː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِسْتَمْطَرَ (istamṭara)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
